verdict.rationale: Adyen's Agentic Feed API maps merchant product data, with real-time catalog, inventory and live pricing, and syncs it to AI platforms like OpenAI and Meta. Agent platforms can also run ACP/UCP checkout sessions through Adyen that return totals and fulfillment options. However, the evidence frames the feed as merchant-to-platform push rather than a developer-readable offer endpoint, and offer-level fields are only implied. Missing for 10: documented developer read access to offer data, explicit variant and checkout-link fields in the feed schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.
